public_declarations.name: reciprocal_le_zeta
public_declarations.signature:
theorem reciprocal_le_zeta {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (η : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (u : ℂ) (hu : 1 < u.re) : ‖reciprocalL η u‖ ≤ ‖riemannZeta (u.re : ℂ)‖

public_declarations.name: relative_reciprocal_bound
public_declarations.signature:
theorem relative_reciprocal_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (η : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (s : ℂ),
      1/2 < s.re → s.re ≤ 3/2 → (s.re-1/2)*‖reciprocalL η (2*s)‖ ≤ C

public_declarations.name: gamma_inverse_strip
public_declarations.signature:
theorem gamma_inverse_strip :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ s : ℂ, 1/2 ≤ s.re → s.re ≤ 3/2 → 1 ≤ |s.im| →
      ‖(Complex.Gamma s)⁻¹‖ ≤ B*Real.exp (Real.pi*|s.im|)

public_declarations.name: original_ordinary_factors
public_declarations.signature:
theorem original_ordinary_factors {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ s : ℂ, 1/2 < s.re → s.re ≤ 3/2 → 1 ≤ |s.im| →
      (s.re-1/2)*‖uncompletionFactor χ s‖ ≤ C*Real.exp (Real.pi*|s.im|) ∧
      (s.re-1/2)*‖principalFactor s‖ ≤ C*Real.exp (Real.pi*|s.im|)
